title: Urban traffic induced demand
goal: A transport planner can see the balancing induced-demand feedback of road expansion.

rubric.must: Every causal arrow visibly has a polarity marker.
A named induced-demand loop is visibly marked balancing (B).
The closed loop visibly links capacity, travel time, attractiveness, trips, and congestion.
The loop label is placed in a readable open loop area.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/causalloop/ideal.svg (sha256 dd3e7464cebc). Delay hashes placed on their curve using the quadratic midpoint. Loop labels matched by polarity; unmatched source declarations are reported, not silently attached to the wrong loop. Footer and loop labels separated. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots.
